cultural.vision_reason: Documentary photo of two Hill Anga women in traditional dress with waist-belts, carrying infants in slings, matching the museum's description of the claimed people's daily life.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, profile half-length portrait of two Hill Anga adult females standing outdoors. Wearing waist-decorations or belts, carrying young children in slings on backs. One also carrying calabash. Outdoor setting, vegetation in background.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
